video_title: Are Hart & Bridges Holding the Knicks Back? | Finch Calls Out Gobert

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' unique style and coaching in Anthony Edwards' absence
quotes.excerpt: how the team is gelling, how they play this super unique style, how their coach is not afraid
quotes.quote: I am just fascinated by what the Timberwolves are doing in Anthony Edwards' absence and just how the team is gelling, how they play this super unique style, how their coach is not afraid to call people out publicly. They are just an interesting team. We talked about it when we had Ethan up here. We talked about Anthony Edwards and D'Angelo Russell being unpolished NBA players in the sense that they are not these media-trained to shit professional athletes. These guys feel like human beings, but I feel like that is the whole Timberwolves on a certain level and it is really fun to watch.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart's struggles and injury issues with the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Josh Hart is averaging a career low 6.6 points per game. He has been hampered with a sore ankle
quotes.quote: Josh Hart is averaging a career low 6.6 points per game. He has been hampered with a sore ankle and illness. He has not scored more than 10 points since October 25th, was 0 for 4 from the field against the Pacers on Friday, 0 for 5 against the Raptors tonight. Benched in the fourth until he came in at the very end for some defense only possessions that the Knicks had.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' reliance on an underdog mentality and identity
quotes.excerpt: The big advantage that they had was they played with an edge and they played as an underdog.
quotes.quote: I worked for MSG covering the team for almost five straight years. I got there the year before Jalen Brunson got there and the conversation was, did they overpay? It was that last level of Julius Randle being the focal point. So I saw the full run up close and personal and the big advantage that they had was they played with an edge and they played as an underdog. It was legitimately every single player on their team's identity. Go back to Isaiah Hartenstein, Josh Hart, Jalen Brunson, you know that story. Josh Hart, you know that story. Mitchell Robinson was a guy that was talked about for being, we gave up too much for him. They cannot win a title with him. Cat, we know the slander he is taking throughout the league.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: James Dolan's stance on contract extensions and team spending
quotes.excerpt: James Dolan basically being like, I am not talking about contract extensions no more. I am off of that.
quotes.quote: What is looming over this, which we have talked about many times on the show, is James Dolan basically being like, I am not talking about contract extensions no more. I am off of that. We are tabling the discussions. We are not going into the apron. All of this tough talk about spending money, which is just absurd when an owner who just wants a championship, you have a roster that is proven is championship-worthy and you are talking about second apron.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart and Mikal Bridges' low scoring production
quotes.excerpt: Josh Hart is playing 30 minutes a game. Mikal Bridges is only playing 24.8 minutes a game.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' strong performance and season outlook
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns is playing phenomenally. 12 games into the season, he is averaging 31.6 minutes a game.
quotes.quote: I want to highlight a guy who is not buckling under the pressure of the weight of a new deal and that is Karl-Anthony Towns. He is playing phenomenally. 12 games into the season, he is averaging 31.6 minutes a game. So that is another thing that folks need to just calm down. Mike Brown is clearly not taking the regular season ultra-serious. D.A. was getting minutes against the Pacers. I got some Wiseman sightings tonight. Mike Brown is treating the regular season like a laboratory. He is keeping his guys' minutes down. Karl-Anthony Towns is playing 31.6 minutes a game. In those 31.6 minutes, shooting 54% from the field, 40 from deep, good for 21, averaging 13.7 boards, only 2.8 personal fouls a game.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Rudy Gobert's struggles and Chris Finch's criticism
quotes.excerpt: Rudy Gobert their starting center was 0 for 7 from the floor. The fourth time the season
quotes.quote: Rudy Gobert their starting center was 0 for 7 from the floor. The fourth time the season he is played an entire game without making a field goal. He had six such games in the previous 13 seasons. Lord have mercy. This is a quote from Chris Finch, pretty harsh here, harsh words. Quote, he has not been able to finish, Chris Finch said. He is getting stripped. He is missing layups. He is not finishing strong. He has got to get on balance, collect and finish strong. Sometimes it is going to be through contact, but we need him to get his finishing back around the paint.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' remarkable career and assist milestone
quotes.excerpt: LeBron Raymone James, Akron's own, passed Jayson Kidd for third all-time in assists in career assists
quotes.quote: LeBron Raymone James, Akron's own, passed Jayson Kidd for third all-time in assists in career assists, which is just nuts that this guy is the greatest scorer, points total in NBA history and now is third and still climbing in assists, Sean. I just think that is just a remarkable fact of LeBron James' career.
